mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS special_spec ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, operation INTEGER NOT NULL, part_no VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, changed_part_no VARCHAR(100), changed_quantity INTEGER, required_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL )
ALTER TABLE special_spec ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS required_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
mapper.select: SELECT operation, part_no AS partNo, quantity, changed_part_no AS changedPartNo, changed_quantity AS changedQuantity, required_quantity AS requiredQuantity FROM special_spec ORDER BY id
